# Spring Boot Observability Engine

Observability configuration governance is consolidated in `spring-boot-actuator.instructions.md`, which covers actuator endpoint exposure, management server port, health detail policy, metrics visibility, profile-level posture, and security boundaries.

Activate `spring-boot-actuator.instructions.md` whenever actuator endpoints, health checks, metrics, or management server configuration in `application*.yml` are introduced or modified.
